sources.name: Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library
sources.notes: Public repository archived 2026-10-02; multi-GB and source assets are not GLB-ready. Keep license notice when distributing.

sources.name: Quaternius Universal Base Characters Standard
sources.license: CC0-1.0 as displayed on specific 2025 pack page
sources.access: free name-your-price download requires provider download flow
sources.advertised_content: Six bases across overall pack; Standard ZIP 122 MB; verify Standard contents on acquisition
sources.notes: Do not assume paid Source tier is included; newer Quaternius releases may use QAL, so evaluate per pack.

sources.name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library Standard
sources.access: free name-your-price download requires provider download flow
sources.advertised_content: 120+ across full offering; Standard ZIP 15 MB; Standard exact tracks not verified
sources.notes: Root-motion and in-place variants; skeleton compatibility and individual animations require validation.

sources.name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library 2 Standard
sources.access: free name-your-price download requires provider download flow
sources.advertised_content: 130+ across full offering; Standard ZIP 17 MB; Standard exact tracks not verified
sources.notes: Do not infer current free subset or claim all full-library animations are in Standard.

sources.name: MakeHuman / MPFB
sources.license: Core exported assets generally CC0; community assets vary
sources.advertised_content: Custom body and face generator; no pre-generated avatar ZIP cataloged
sources.notes: Generated characters must be created, exported, and audited individually. Software license differs from model-export license.

sources.name: VRoid Studio
sources.license: User-created VRM rights and third-party wardrobe terms are item-dependent
sources.notes: Do not treat third-party VRM avatars as CC0. Reuse in Three.js requires three-vrm.

sources.name: Adobe Mixamo
sources.license: Adobe/Mixamo terms: finished projects yes; stand-alone raw asset redistribution restricted
sources.access: Adobe login; download requires user-controlled account
sources.advertised_content: Character and animation selection service; no finite complete ZIP defined
sources.notes: Do not scrape or bulk-download through someone else's account. Preserve acquired file scope and provider usage restrictions.
